# Erio Coaching Websites — Full Details

> A done-for-you custom coaching website built by experts in under 24 hours for a one-time $27, with booking calendar, lead capture, and professional sales copy included. https://coach.erio.ai/

## The Offer

- **What:** A fully custom-designed online coaching website, built FOR the coach by Erio's expert designers and copywriters. Not a template, not a DIY builder.
- **Price:** $27 one-time for the complete build.
- **Speed:** Delivered within 12–24 hours of ordering.
- **Who it's for:** Life coaches, executive coaches, online coaches, business coaches, and consultants — especially new coaches on a budget and coaches tired of DIY website builders.
- **Included:** Custom design around the coach's brand (their logo, colors, images, details) · every service professionally written with sales-converting copy · built-in booking calendar synced to the coach's real availability with automatic confirmations and reminders · lead-capture forms pre-installed · mobile-optimized.
- **Guarantee:** 30-day 100% money-back guarantee.
- **Hosting:** Like every website, it needs hosting to stay online. Plans start at $47/mo (site hosting, maintenance, security, cloud storage, calendar system, AI app builder, AI social media generator). Chosen after delivery; cancel anytime.
- **How ordering works:** Pay $27 → fill out one simple form (services, logo, colors, details) → experts build the site → delivered within 24 hours, fully owned by the coach.
- **Contact:** support@erio.ai · Erio LLC.

## Why coaches choose it over the alternatives

- **vs. DIY builders (Wix, Squarespace, Kajabi):** those cost $20–$140/month AND require the coach to design, write, and configure everything themselves. Erio does 100% of the work for $27 one-time.
- **vs. agencies/freelancers:** typical custom coaching website quotes run $1,000–$10,000 and take weeks. Erio delivers a custom build in 24 hours for $27.
- **vs. templates ($49–$300):** a template still needs the coach to customize and write copy. Erio's finished site costs less than the template alone.
- **Built to book calls, not just look pretty:** sales-converting service copy, lead capture, and a booking calendar working front and center.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Does my website need hosting to stay online?**
Yes — every website on the internet needs hosting, no exceptions. After the $27 build, hosting plans start at $47/mo and include site hosting, maintenance, security, cloud storage, a calendar system, an AI app builder, and an AI social media generator. Cancel anytime.

**What if I already have a website?**
Most coaching websites are built to be pretty, not to book calls — missing sales copy, lead capture, and a booking calendar. Erio builds a new one set up correctly from day one, for less than most people pay for a month of their old site's hosting.

**Do expert-written services and a booking calendar come with the website?**
Yes. Every service is professionally written with proven sales-converting copy, and the booking calendar plus lead-capture forms come fully installed.

**Do I pick the exact services on my website?**
Yes, 100%. The order form asks for the exact services offered, and the site is built around them — no generic filler. Services can be edited later in a couple of clicks.

**Does Erio advertise the site for me?**
No — Erio does not run ads for you. The site itself is optimized for sales.

**Do I need tech skills?**
None. Erio handles 100% of the building, setup, and technical work. Fully done-for-you.

**How do people book calls through the website?**
Automatically: visitors click to book, pick a time from the coach's real availability, it lands on the coach's calendar, and both sides get confirmations and reminders.

**Are these pre-built templates?**
No. Every website is custom built around the coach's brand from the order form details.

**When do I get the website and do I own it?**
Delivered 12–24 hours after ordering, and it is 100% the coach's to use.

**Is there a refund?**
Yes — a 30-day 100% money-back guarantee.

**How much does a coaching website cost with Erio?**
$27 one-time for the custom build, delivered in 24 hours. Hosting from $47/mo afterwards.
